accepted_plan.summary: Align Workspace server SQLite bootstrap/migrations and tests with the canonical `schema-v0.md` artifact: typed repository/ticket-target/worker-link/artifact/audit schema, no canonical runs/hosts/workers/generic JSON/validation result tables, while preserving filesystem Ticket/Objective authority and existing read APIs.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation/design alignment commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates workspace-server schema/tests/Nix if needed, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
